newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Peters hopes to end NZ talks "in next few weeks".
newsitem.headline: Peters hopes to end NZ talks "in next few weeks".

text.p: New Zealand First leader Winston Peters said on Tuesday he hoped to conclude coalition negotiations in the next few weeks.
"Everyone hopes it will be in the next few weeks -- so do we," Peters told reporters after his latest meeting with the caretaker National Party government.
He restated that he wished to "debunk" the rumour that NZ First, which is also negotiating with Labour, had indicated a preference for one party or the other.
New Zealand First holds the balance of power after a general election on October 12. Both National and Labour say they aim to form a government with its support.
